title: VPN: first checks
text: Confirm your internet works by opening any website. Open Cisco AnyConnect and verify the gateway is vpn.corp.local. Disconnect other VPN or proxy tools, then reconnect.

title: VPN Error 809
text: Error 809 means the VPN tunnel could not be established, usually because UDP 500/4500 is blocked on the current network. Switch to another network or a mobile hotspot, restart AnyConnect and reconnect. If it persists, escalate to Network-Ops with the error code.

title: VPN Error 619
text: Error 619 means the remote gateway ended the session. Make sure you are not already connected on another device, wait two minutes, then reconnect.

title: VPN certificate warning
text: Never accept or bypass a certificate warning. Confirm the gateway name is vpn.corp.local and report the warning to Network-Ops through a ticket.

title: VPN connected but intranet not loading
text: If the VPN shows connected but intranet sites do not load, flush the DNS cache (Windows: ipconfig /flushdns), disconnect and reconnect, then test an internal site again.

title: VPN keeps asking for MFA
text: Approve the Microsoft Authenticator push within 60 seconds and make sure the phone date and time are set to automatic. If prompts keep looping, see KB-301 or raise an MFA ticket.

title: MFA push not received
text: Open Microsoft Authenticator manually, check the phone has internet access, allow notifications for the app, then request a new push.

title: Lost or replaced phone (privileged)
text: MFA reset for a lost or replaced device cannot be done by L1 support. IAM must verify your identity first, so a ticket to IAM-L2 is raised with your approval.

title: MFA code rejected
text: Set the phone time to automatic. Codes are valid for about 30 seconds, so wait for a fresh code and enter it promptly.

title: Account locked
text: Accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes. Use the self-service password portal to unlock sooner. Never share your password with anyone, including support.

title: Password expired or reset
text: Use the self-service password reset portal and choose a new password of at least 12 characters that you have not used before.

title: Outlook not syncing
text: Check the Outlook status bar and turn off Working Offline. Check service health, then restart Outlook.

title: Rebuild Outlook profile
text: Open Control Panel, then Mail, create a new profile and sign in with your corporate UPN. Set it as the default profile and restart Outlook.

title: Outlook asks for password repeatedly
text: Sign out of all Office apps, remove cached Office entries in Credential Manager, then sign in again and approve MFA.

title: Mailbox full
text: Archive or delete large items, empty Deleted Items and check the mailbox quota in account settings. Quota increases require a ticket.

title: No audio in Teams
text: Check the selected speaker and microphone in Teams device settings, make a test call, restart Teams and install pending updates.

title: Printer offline
text: Check the printer power and network cable or Wi-Fi, set it as the default printer, clear the print queue and print a test page.

title: Print queue stuck
text: Cancel all documents in the queue, restart the Print Spooler service from Services, then resend a single job.

title: Cannot find network printer
text: Add the printer using the approved print server path from the service catalog and confirm you are on the corporate network or VPN.

title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet
text: Forget and rejoin the corporate Wi-Fi, restart the device and try a wired connection. Check service health for network outages.

title: Slow network
text: Run a speed test, close bandwidth-heavy apps and move closer to the access point. Report repeated slowness with the location and time.

title: Laptop running slow
text: Restart the device, close unused apps, keep at least 10 percent disk space free and install pending updates.

title: Software install request
text: Install only from the approved Software Center. Other software requires an approved request through a ticket.

title: 311 grievance status
text: Look up a grievance with its reference ID (format GRV-123456). Status shown in this demo is synthetic fixture data, not live NDMC data.

title: Water and electricity complaints
text: Water supply status is checked by ward number. Do not share consumer or personal identifiers in chat. Demo fixtures only.

title: Certificate services portal
text: For certificate portal problems check service status first, then raise a ticket to NDMC-Portal-Ops with the reference ID.

title: Escalation policy
text: Escalate when two troubleshooting attempts fail, the issue is privileged (identity or access), or the user asks. Priority is set from impact and urgency.

title: Service health first
text: Check service health before troubleshooting. If a service is degraded, wait for the incident update instead of repeating resets.

title: Security basics
text: Never share passwords, MFA codes or tokens. IT staff never ask for them. Report phishing emails to the security mailbox.
